sources.title: laurataylor/dino-classification · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Dino for Classification Overview A small Dino implementation for Classification, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The base variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: TexasInstruments/DINO-Classification · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview DINO (Self- Di stillation with No labels) is a self-supervised Vision Transformer pre-training method from Meta AI. The backbone models produce rich feature embeddings that achieve strong performance on ImageNet classification without any labels during pre-training.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro | Google's Most Advanced AI Model 2026
sources.snippet: Gemini 3.1 Pro by Google DeepMind: 77.1% ARC-AGI-2, 94.3% GPQA Diamond, 80.6% SWE-Bench, 1M token context, native SVG rendering. The most capable Gemini model available.

sources.title: deepseek-v4.1-flash Model by Deepseek-ai | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek-AI that accepts text and images, generates text autoregressively, supports a combined context of up to one million tokens, and provides continuously controllable reasoning effort.
